findings.message: In the section 2.1 verb table, the second column is `Lock`. Every other row uses lowercase `no` / `yes` / `commit only` to say whether the verb takes the writer lock. The stdio server itself holds no lock: the new CLI help says `lock="Per-tool domain locks; no lock held by the stdio server."`, and only individual tools take their domain locks.
